title: Bulk RNA sequencing of pleural mesothelioma tumor
policy_title: FunGeST - Functional Genomics from cancer research to personalized medicine
dac_name: FunGeST - Functional Genomics from cancer research to personalized medicine
description: This dataset contains bulk RNA sequencing data generated from pleural mesothelioma tumor samples. Transcriptomic analyses were used to characterize tumor phenotypes and to evaluate the clinical relevance of four expression profiles: epithelioid, intermediate, sarcomatoid, and non-differentiated. The identified transcriptional phenotypes were assessed in larger patient cohorts and were associated with overall survival. These data support the molecular characterization of pleural mesothelioma heterogeneity and the study of tumor progression toward a sarcomatoid phenotype.
